name: Bai Shu Chuan Shui
source:
The Shu Legend is a visual novel exploring history and memory. In a Dog Clan-ruled apocalypse plagued by war and famine, the bandit Shi Jin drifts through life. A routine robbery sparks a fateful event, unveiling a dark historical truth long buried by the clan.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4710650/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《蜀国传奇》是一部探索历史和记忆的视觉小说。在狗族统治的、饱受战争和饥荒困扰的末世中，强盗石进的人生漂泊不定。一次例行抢劫引发了一场致命事件，揭开了家族长期埋藏的黑暗历史真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4710650/]Steam[/url]]
